description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core action filter class ValidatorActionFilter that validates the model state before executing an action and returns JSON-formatted errors if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A custom implementation of IActionFilter that validates model state and returns error details in JSON format when validation fails.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks the validity of the model state before the action executes, returning a JSON error response with status 422 if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: An empty implementation of IActionFilter's method, no operation after the action executes.
